description: This file contains shared utility functions for mapping statuses or strings to colors, used mainly for visual consistency in dashboards with dark backgrounds. It defines functions 'colorFromString' for deterministic pastel HSL color generation, and 'getStatusColor' for mapping statuses to theme colors or generating colors based on string hashes.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different inputs while maintaining consistent saturation and lightness.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps various status strings to theme colors, providing fallbacks to deterministic colors based on string hashes, with specific mappings for common statuses like 'processing', 'success', 'failed', or 'unknown'.
